title: fix(connector-openapi): send each parameter by its declared style and explode
body:
Fixes #28504
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:OpenAPI 连接器发请求时,query / path / header 参数按文档声明的 `style` / `explode`(或 OpenAPI 3.x 默认值)编码,对象和数组不再经 `String()` 变成 `[object Object]` 或逗号串。
- 为什么改:Stripe 等厂商的列表接口用 `deepObject` 传日期区间和 `expand`,此前请求被静默发错、运行却答 200;作者和 AI 按 schema 填参也照样发错。
- 风险与回滚:标量参数逐字节不变(对照用例在旧代码上同样通过);新增两处拒绝——文档给某位置声明了未定义的 style 时启动失败(仓内 2 份文档 42 个参数实测 0 命中),值的形状无编码时该步失败且不发请求。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/parameter-serialization.ts`(`serializeQueryParameter` 与 `deepPairs`,deepObject 数组取下标括号);`openapi-connector.ts` 的 `parameterEncodings` / `withAuthQuery`(启动期拒绝与 api-key 合并);`parameter-style.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-openapi exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/parameter-style.test.ts`,预期 17 passed,其中 Stripe 的 `created` 发成 `created%5Bgte%5D=1700000000`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- New `src/parameter-serialization.ts`: each sent parameter is encoded by its Parameter Object's `style` / `explode`, or by its location's OpenAPI 3.x default when it declares none (query `form`, exploded; path and header `simple`). Implemented: query `form`, `spaceDelimited`, `pipeDelimited`, `deepObject`; path `simple`, `label`, `matrix`; header `simple`. Scalars are the only values that become text.
- `deepObject` on an array (Stripe's `expand`) brackets each index, `expand[0]=a&expand[1]=b`: the style's own rule (each property in brackets) applied to the array's keys, rather than a guessed `expand[]` convention. Nested values recurse the same way.
- Materialization refusal: a parameter whose `style` OpenAPI 3.x does not define for its location, or a non-boolean `explode`, throws from `createOpenApiConnector` naming the operation, the parameter and the style (fatal at boot for a declarative instance; `include` that leaves the operation out clears it).
- Dispatch refusal (`ParameterValueError`): a value the declared style has no encoding for (an array of objects for `form`, an object for exploded `spaceDelimited`, any non-scalar for a `content`-typed parameter) fails the step before `fetch` is called.
- Query pairs travel as an ordered list; the static api-key query credential still replaces a same-named input pair in place, as before.
- `OpenApiParameter` gains optional `style`, `explode`, `content`.
- Docs: `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` states how parameters are sent and adds the two refusals to the failure table; `packages/apps/connector-stripe/README.md` Limits bullet, which told authors to leave `expand` / `created[gte]` out, now says how they are sent (this change made it false).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/connector-openapi` patch.

## Tests

- `src/parameter-style.test.ts` (17): the three Stripe shapes with `GetInvoices`' five parameter objects copied verbatim from Stripe's document (MIT), equal to the packaged `connector-stripe` document's objects (one-off canonical-JSON compare: `equal true`); two scalar controls (query and path); the style table; the auth-merge case; both refusals, the dispatch refusal asserting the error class and zero `fetch` calls.
- Ablation (one-off, base `openapi-connector.ts` swapped in, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, hash re-matched): 15 failed / 2 passed of 17. The 2 that stay green are the scalar controls, so scalar output is byte-identical to the old code. Old outputs read off the failures: `created=%5Bobject+Object%5D`, `expand=data.customer%2Cdata.subscription`, `due_date=%5Bobject+Object%5D`.
- Public door, one-off probe (not committed): the packaged Stripe app booted with `bootStack`, a flow calling `GetInvoices` via `POST /api/v1/automation/:flow/trigger` answered 200 and the fake Stripe received `https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices?created%5Bgte%5D=1700000000&due_date%5Bgte%5D=1700000000&due_date%5Blt%5D=1702592000&expand%5B0%5D=data.customer&expand%5B1%5D=data.subscription&limit=3`.

## Acceptance notes

- Stripe's own answer to `expand[0]=…` and `created[gte]=…` is NOT MEASURED (no key); the tests run against a fake Stripe.
- `allowReserved` is not read: reserved characters stay percent-encoded, as before.
- Cookie parameters are still left out of the action's input schema and never sent (unchanged).
- Query delimiters are form-urlencoded with the values (`,` as `%2C`, a space as `+`, `|` as `%7C`), which is how a scalar was always encoded; path delimiters stay literal.
- An empty array or object sends nothing (RFC 6570 treats it as undefined).
